o: ? What's this?
Who is this?

chat.t: Ah...
It's me, Sophia!
I asked you earlier if you'd like to do some volunteer work with me! Hehe

o: Volunteer work? Out of nowhere?

chat.t: Oh?
Hmm... Is this not {player}'s contact number?
The one who collapsed in the alleyway?

o: Wait...
It's starting to ring a bell.
I guess that was my number.

chat.t: Pardon?

o: I don't think I can do the volunteer work.
I've been a bit busy lately.

chat.t: Ah...
Oh, I see...
I'm sorry, I made such a sudden and unreasonable request, didn't I?
I must have gotten too excited and misunderstood. I'm sorry.
Please give it some positive thought and contact me next time!
Still, what should I do...
Now we're going to have extra lunch boxes left over for the helpers...
No one is around to eat them, so I guess we'll have to throw them away, as wasteful as it is...

o: Hmm.
Well, if that's the case, I guess I have no choice.
Where should I go?

chat.t: Oh, really? Thank you so much!
Then please refer to the photo I sent, and I'll see you tomorrow!

o: I'm definitely getting a lunch box, right?

chat.t: Of course! Hehe

lines.t: A few hours before receiving the message
Oh my goodness!!
Excuse me, are you okay?!
Somewhere in Humanitas
Ugh...
I hear a voice from somewhere...
Thank goodness, are you waking up?
Whew, that was close. I can't believe you collapsed in a place like this...
Thirsty...
Ah! Just a moment!
Here, have some water.
Mmh, your vitals seem stable...
Do you feel uncomfortable anywhere?
Hungry...
Oh, here, have this!
It's only an energy bar, but it should help a little.
Hehe, I'm glad you seem to be feeling better.
...Oh! That's not what's important right now!
Now that you're feeling a bit better, let's go get you checked out!
Just in case there's something wrong with your body.
An exam?  Does that mean I have to take all my clothes off?
Pardon?  Uh, well... you don't necessarily have to...
If you'd like, I can give you a quick checkup right here.
Ah, now that I think about it, I haven't introduced myself yet.
I'm Sophia, and I work as a nurse at a place called <Saverim>.
Hehe, I'm not a suspicious person, so don't worry too much!
(...Is she going to ask for money later?)
(Let's make up an excuse.)
I'm fine, really. I was just lying down because I was hungry.
Pardon? Lying down because you were hungry...?
In the m-middle of an alleyway...?
Well, that's just how life is sometimes.
You gotta pinch pennies when you're broke.
I-I see...
Right, of course there are people who live like this.
I knew it... I'm glad I came out here myself.
Huh?
Ah, it was nothing. Just talking to myself.
(Come to think of it...)
(Giving me free water and food is pretty suspicious...)
—If you don't mind, would you like to join me?
Join you? In doing what?
Why, volunteer work, of course!
Since fate brought us together, what do you say?
(I knew she had an ulterior motive.)
Ah, I'm a bit busy right now. I'll be on my way.
Ah!!!
W-Wait a moment! You shouldn't move so suddenly!!
Your body probably hasn't fully recovered yet!!
Yeah, yeah, I get it.
Here, this is my business card. Contact me later.
W-Wait, what?! Oh, no, you shouldn't...!!
I-In that case, I'll contact you again in a bit, okay?!
Sure, sure, let's meet up sometime soon.

After tossing her a random business card I had on hand,
I dashed out of the alleyway like a flash.

chat.t: {player}, good morning! Hehe
Today is the day for our volunteer work! ^_^
The weather is absolutely lovely!
{player}, are you there?
{player}, please contact me when you see this message!
They said the helpers will be having breakfast in 30 minutes!

o: You should have said that first.

chat.t: {player}, you did a great job today!
I was surprised because you did so well even though it was your first time! Hehehe
I look forward to working with you tomorrow, too!

o: Tomorrow? You want me to come tomorrow, too?

chat.t: Of course, if you're busy, I understand!
Just please let me know in advance!
Because we have to adjust the quantity when ordering the lunch boxes!
So, what would you like to do about tomorrow?

o: Hmm.
Tomorrow is seriously the absolute last time.

chat.t: Okay! See you tomorrow! Hehe

lines.t: Since I happened to be hungry, I headed to the location Sophia told me about.
Volunteer Event Venue
Ah, here you are!
{player}, how was your meal?  Isn't it super delicious?
Well, it wasn't bad.
Hehe, I'm glad to hear that.
We'll be starting in a moment. Are you ready?
So what exactly am I supposed to do?
Ah, did I not mention it?
This volunteer work is about serving meals to the underprivileged.
While I'm at it, if anyone needs medical assistance, I also provide them with a quick checkup.
Hehe, but actually, what's more important than that is having everyone gather in one place.
That in itself holds great meaning.
Well, I don't really know about all that. But is there a particular reason why you go out of your way to do this?
A reason... you say?
Hmm, not really. It's just something I want to do.
Sounds exhausting.
Hehe, I hear that quite often.
Speaking of which, I could use some help too.
Oh, really?
It's truly difficult to help others when you yourself are struggling...
As expected, {player}, you're amazing!
No, what I meant was—
Hehe, understood! Then let's start right away!
The task I will entrust to {player} is serving food.
Since all you have to do is give one to each person, it shouldn't be too hard.
I'll leave it in your hands!
No, wait, sigh...
And so, the sudden volunteer work began.
Thank you.  Gym Uniform Girl A
lines.n: Gym Uniform Girl A in a Mask

lines.t:
Still, every single one of the people coming to get food was so unique
that it was actually quite entertaining to watch.
Thank you, Master.
Meanwhile...
Sank yooou.
lines.n: Gym Uniform Girl A in a Mask

lines.t: Hold it right there.
Y-Yes?
lines.n: Gym Uniform Girl A in a Mask

lines.t: Take off your mask.
...Cough, cough!
lines.n: Gym Uniform Girl A in a Mask

lines.t: I-I caught a bad flu...
lines.n: Gym Uniform Girl A in a Mask

lines.t: Take it off while I'm still asking nicely.
W-Well, that is...
lines.n: Gym Uniform Girl A in a Mask

lines.t: Oh, is something the matter?
I just have something to double-check.
Huh...?
Ah, you're the person who came last time too, right?
Oh, a mask? Did you catch a cold?
Huh?
Pardon?
lines.n: Gym Uniform Girl A in a Mask

lines.t: ...Ah, yes. I'm feelin' much better now.
lines.n: Gym Uniform Girl A in a Mask

lines.t: That's good. Please let me know if you need anything.
...Sob. Th-Thank you so much!
lines.n: Gym Uniform Girl A in a Mask

lines.t: Do you know her?
Yes, she has a very unique way of speaking, so she stood out.
Hmm, is that so?
Hehe, yes, indeed.
Now then,  please continue to do your best—
KABOOM!!!
Kyaaaaah!!
What is it this time?!
Excuse us, Masters, but please do not move from where you are!
Now, put down all the lunch boxes you are holding!
Gasp! The Maid Phantom Thieves!!
lines.n: Gym Uniform Girl A in a Mask

lines.t: Do you know who they are?
Yes! They are a notorious gang that crashes every free giveaway event and sweeps away absolutely everything!!
lines.n: Gym Uniform Girl A in a Mask

lines.t: What? Did they run away because the Head Maid spanked them too much?
...By the way, you suddenly speak very fluently.

lines.n: Gym Uniform Girl A in a Mask

lines.t: N-No, it is not. You are just imagining things, yooou.
lines.n: Gym Uniform Girl A in a Mask

lines.t: I-Is everyone alright?!
I'm fine, but more importantly...

The venue was in absolute chaos
after the sudden attack by the Maid Phantom Thieves.
How are we going to clean up this mess?
Ah! You Masters over there! We told you not to move!
I see words won't work on you! We will have to teach you a lesson!
...Since you've ruined such an important event, I can't just let you slide.
Prepare yourselves, Maids!
Ugh, is this as far as we go...
Guh... the Masters are too strong...
Well, then.
Now it's time for some fun punishment.
...P-Punishment?
Y-You never mentioned anything like that!
You caused all this chaos, so you have to take responsibility.
W-What on earth are you planning to make us do...?!
D-Don't tell me... you're going to do this or that to us...!
Well, I'm a generous guy.
Hand over the underwear you're wearing right now.  And I'll let you off the hook.
...What?  O-Our underwear?
Oh... you're going to forgive us for just that?
{player}, excuse me?  That's not what we're doing here!
No, this is absolutely correct.
Sigh... please save those mischievous jokes for later.
But I do agree that the two of you need to take responsibility.
Since you turned the venue into such a mess, right?
Eek!
P-Please, anything but physical pain...
Oh, goodness, it's nothing like that.
Ahem. First, please help clean up this place.
And after that, make me a promise.
Promise me that you'll come and help us with tomorrow's volunteer work!
...Huh?
Ehh?
Ah, of course, I can't pay you.
Though we will give you a lunch box!
Forget that,  just give me your underwear.

chat.t: Good morning, {player}!
Today is the last day of our volunteer work! ^_^
By the way!
I never expected you to participate so consistently!! :D
Thank you so much for working so hard despite your busy schedule!

o: Sure thing.

chat.t: Hehehe
Let's do our best until the very end!!
{player}, you did an amazing job during this time!
Let's meet again if we get the chance! :D
Or you could come to where I work for a checkup! Hehe

o: Is all your urgent business done?

chat.t: You're teasing me again, aren't you?

o: I wonder?

chat.t: Oh, seriously!
You definitely are teasing! >_<

o: I am not. >_<

chat.t: Hahahahaha, seriously, what are you even doing?
Okay, let's go with that then! Hehe
Oh, and this is another matter entirely...
I'm so grateful to you for working so hard on the volunteer work,
that I'd like to personally thank you with a reward later...
May I contact you again when that time comes? Hehe...

o: Sure
Contact me if you get any more meal tickets for that place we went today.

chat.t: Oh, goodness! Hehe
I'll contact you next time then! :D

lines.t: Volunteer Event Venue

After the Maid Phantom Thieves, or whatever they were called,
attacked on the first day of volunteering...
Surprisingly, after that, the event ended without any further trouble.
Ah, {player} !
I heard today's schedule ends here.
Fufu, thank you so much for your hard work!
It really ended without any trouble.
Oh my... You look somewhat disappointed.
Well, having some fun is better than being this bored.
And I can play all kinds of pranks.
Huh? P-Pranks...?
...Ah. Honestly, you're saying mean things on purpose again, aren't you?
If you keep doing that, everyone will misunderstand!
Never mind that, what's going on?
Yes? Uh, um... It's not that there's anything in particular...
...Oh, that's right! Would you like to go have an after-party together?
The organizers gave me a restaurant meal voucher.
I heard it's a very famous restaurant!
Let's go right now.
Fufu! I'd love to!
Then I will go say a quick goodbye, so please wait just a moment!
Phew, that was a great meal.
Wow... That was truly amazing!
That was my first time at such a high-class restaurant...
And the food was absolutely delicious...
Volunteering isn't so bad after all.
Oh, really?
Then would you like to do it together again if we get another chance?
Well, if I'm not busy.
Fufu, is that a promise?
Sure, sure.
I'm heading out now.
Ah!
{player}, wait, please wait a moment!
Why?
I have something to give you, hehe...
Sophia pulled something out of her pocket.
This is...
A business card?
Yes. I realized I had never given you mine.
Things were a bit chaotic in that alleyway before...
And I'm so grateful that you worked as hard on the volunteer activities as if they were your own.
So I'm giving this to you so you'll definitely come visit me later.
Next time you come, I will give you a proper checkup!
It's fine. It wasn't even that big of a deal.
...Fufu.
Does it matter how much you did, or whether it was a big deal?
What truly matters is the heart you put into it.
I just wanted a free meal. No need to bring "heart" into it.
Oh? Fufu, so you finally admit it.
Anyway, I'm sure what I've seen and heard isn't everything, but...
That's what I think. {player} is definitely a kind person.
Someone who listens to a stranger's request and can easily forgive others.
And I happen to really like people like that.
You know, I pride myself on being a pretty good judge of character.
Hmm, is that so?
Well then, out of appreciation for your sincerity, maybe I'll stop by sometime.
Fufu. Yes, you are always welcome!
By the way, I take everything off for the checkup, right?
...Yes?
I was just wondering if you examine every nook and cranny.
Oh, um... You d-don't really have to go that far—
You're t-teasing me again, aren't you!? Goodness!
I'm not teasing.
Ugh...!
B-But still, you can't!
Why, weren't you going to give me a proper checkup?
I can do it perfectly well without you undressing!
But wouldn't it be even more thorough if I took everything off?
Wh- Well... That might...
I- Is that so...? No, wait, that—
If you want, you can strip too.
Come to think of it, it's unfair if only the patient strips. It makes sense for you to do it too, right?
Ah, w-well... th- that's...
I- I'll, I'll think about it!
Where are you going?
I just remembered I have some urgent business, so I must go now!
S-See you next time!
Stepping backward, Sophia turned around and began to run away.
That was the day I learned Sophia was faster than I expected.
